integrity: The theorem and small-graph classification use exact rational arithmetic. The companion program includes all dependencies and an independent 12-edge-order DP. No external or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact classification only through thirteen vertices; no assertions for larger trees, weighted edge selection, or loss of unimodality/log-concavity. Exhaustive generation uses the standard complete unlabeled-tree enumerator. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: The first non-real-rooted random greedy matching laws on trees occur at thirteen vertices
